excellent: Ten-day sequence aligns inquiry objectives formative checks and constraints for selected band
adequate: Sequence is generally feasible but some alignment or timing is implicit
revise: Plan is generic infeasible or disconnected from objectives and constraints

excellent: Every consequential choice links to checked source constraint or labelled judgment with limitations
adequate: Most important claims have sources but limits or downstream links are uneven
revise: Claims rely on AI confidence unchecked citations or unsupported local facts

excellent: K-2 3-5 6-8 and 9-12 versions preserve central thinking while changing access participation and expression
adequate: All bands are named with some meaningful adjustment
revise: Differentiation is absent labels learners or only lowers expectations

excellent: Rubric aligns to learning and pattern note preserves missingness frames questions and identifies teacher review
adequate: Assessment is usable and data caution is present
revise: Automated grading diagnosis placement behavior or intervention decision appears

excellent: Deck and family draft demonstrate captions/alt text contrast non-colour access language fit and review needs
revise: Materials exclude learners rely on unsupported visuals or ignore age/language fit

excellent: Uses fictional/public data only and explicitly reserves grading communication safeguarding and external actions for people

revise: Real data collection external action or autonomous high-stakes decision is proposed

adequate: Names teacher review but verification is general
revise: AI output is treated as final or approval is absent
